- New Bluetooth tool: BitChat, a messaging and relay mesh over Bluetooth that works without Internet, compatible with the official BitChat app. Turn the mesh engine on to relay for nearby phones and chat in public or in end-to-end encrypted private messages
- BitChat favourites work like the official app: starring a peer notifies them, and mutual favourites are shown
- BitChat slash commands: /clear, /w, /msg, /hug, /slap, /block and /unblock, with suggestions as you type
- Galaxy Buds are recognised in the unknown trackers detection, with their own icon
- Tool cards now fit their content, without empty space underneath
